issue.title: Fork CI reconciler: retry a lost "push again" nudge
issue.body:
When a gated pull request goes from `setup_required` to `awaiting_push`, the reconciler (AIP-120, #74822) edits the state comment and then posts a new comment asking the contributor to push again. If setting the status or posting that comment fails after the state comment was edited, the next run sees `awaiting_push` and never posts the nudge. The contributor gets no prompt before the inactivity closure.

Proposed: post the nudge before recording `awaiting_push` in the state comment, or record in the marker that the nudge is pending and clear it only after it was posted. Add a test where posting the nudge fails once.

Code: `classify` and `apply_plan` in `dev/breeze/src/airflow_breeze/utils/fork_ci_reconcile.py`.
